Subject: Intro — Diego Ramos (SWE) — available this week?

Hi Neha / Laura / Marissa,

Nice to meet you — I’m Pauline at Aurora Staffing. We have a strong candidate for the Senior SWE role: Diego Ramos (resume attached). He’s currently interviewing and excited about Redwood; his profile lines up well with the backend/infra work you described.

Quick highlights:
- Senior backend engineer, 6+ yrs, recent infra work on distributed caching and RPC performance.
- Open to on-site SF / hybrid; starts 3–4 weeks out.
- Compensation expectations: flexible, aligned with the range you shared earlier.

Diego can do panel interviews this week or early next week — his open windows are attached in the Panel_Availability_Sheet.xlsx. If you can propose 2–3 slots we’ll lock them and confirm the candidate.

Hi Pauline — thanks for the intro and the resume.

Good to see his infra background. Quick ask from our side: could we book a 90-minute on-site-style panel (two interviews: system design + coding + 30-minute hiring manager) — total ~90 mins. Panelers available:
- Marissa Cole (panel lead) — prefers mornings 9:30–11:30 PT
- Laura Bennett (engineer) — available 11:00–16:00 PT except Thu 2–4pm
- I’ll join the hiring manager slot; prefer 1:30–4:00 pm PT

If you can propose two concrete 90-min windows based on Diego’s sheet, we’ll confirm. If he prefers remote, that’s fine — we’ll send a video invite.

Also we’d like Diego to complete a short take-home coding exercise only if he’s moving forward after interviews — we’ll hold off unless you recommend it now.

Subject: Post-interview: Diego Ramos — feedback requested

Team — thanks for taking the panel this morning. Quick debrief so we can decide next steps (move to take-home / onsite / decline). Please reply inline with: 1) hire / no-hire / unsure, 2) key strengths (1–2 bullets), 3) major concerns (if any), and 4) recommended next step.

I’ll summarize and share with Aurora after I gather raw feedback.

—Neha
Recruiting Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Samira Khan <samira.k@aurorastaffing.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Feb 2027 14:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-interview: Diego Ramos — feedback requested

Neha —
1) hire (lean yes)
2) Strengths:
- Clear understanding of cache-coherency tradeoffs and low-latency design.
- Good debugging story, practical follow-through on performance improvements.
3) Concerns:
- Coding exercise: slower than average on whiteboard-style problems; hit edge cases but eventually arrived at workable solution.
4) Next step: short take-home to validate algorithmic speed + edge-case handling (2–3 hour exercise).

—Laura
Senior Software Engineer
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Samira Khan <samira.k@aurorastaffing.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Feb 2027 15:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-interview: Diego Ramos — feedback requested

Neha — short summary from me:
1) unsure
2) Strengths: system-thinking, good tradeoffs discussion around consistency and cache invalidation.
3) Concerns: missed a couple of optimization opportunities in the coding portion; not confident on concurrency primitives under load.
4) Next step: take-home (same as Laura) or pair-program quick follow-up if we want to probe concurrency.

I’m fine with a take-home then a short follow-up if results look good.

—Marissa
Sr. Eng Manager, Platform
